hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)'; then (lsof -ti:8502 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; cd /Users/andytsang/Documents/Project/RAG-Agent && nohup .venv/bin/streamlit run app.py --server.port=8502 --server.headless=true >/tmp/streamlit_ragagent.log 2>&1 & disown); echo "$(date): restarted streamlit (8502) after git commit/push" >> /tmp/streamlit_ragagent_restart.log; fi
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if ! git diff-index --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then git add -A && git commit -m "chore: auto checkpoint after session" && git push 2>/dev/null || true; fi
